body:
When it comes to dental floss, the common perception is that all flosses are essentially the same. But, delving deeper into the world of oral hygiene reveals a startling truth: not all flosses are created equal, and the differences can significantly impact your oral health.

The Hidden Dangers in Popular Flosses

Many conventional flosses contain PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene) or other similar chemicals, commonly known as “forever chemicals” due to their persistence in the environment. The Environmental Working Group (EWG) has ranked PTFE and related substances, like PFAS (often found in brand names like Teflon), a concerning 10 out of 10 for toxicity. Moreover, some ‘natural’ flosses, despite their eco-friendly appearance, resort to using petroleum-based waxes such as microcrystalline.

SuperMouth’s Innovative Approach to Flossing

At SuperMouth, we take a different path. Our flosses are meticulously crafted without PTFE or any petroleum-based waxes. Instead, we opt for safer alternatives like beeswax, ensuring that our flosses are not just effective but also environmentally friendly and safe for your body.

Infused with the Goodness of Hydroxamin

Just like you wouldn’t brush your teeth without toothpaste, why would you floss without added benefits? That’s why we’ve infused all our flosses with key ingredients like Hydroxamin (our proprietary blend of nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3 & vitamin K2) and xylitol. Available in both fluoride and fluoride-free variants, this unique blend is designed to support and enhance oral health at a microscopic level.

Delicious Flavors and Tailored Designs

We understand that a pleasant flossing experience is key to consistent oral care. That’s why our flosses come in four delicious flavors: super vanilla, super chocolate, super strawberry, and super mint, making flossing a treat rather than a chore.

In addition to catering to tastes, we recognize that different ages and stages of dental development have distinct needs. Our range includes:

  • Patent-pending character flossers based on our superheroes, perfect for young children.
  • Cylindrical flosses that are part of Flossosaurus’s backpack, turning flossing into an incredibly fun activity for kids.
  • Flosses specifically designed for kids and adults, ensuring effectiveness and comfort for all ages.
  • Ortho flosses with built-in threaders and thicker design, ideal for cleaning around braces, bridges, and implants.

Patented Technology for Superior Cleaning

Most of our flosses incorporate a patented technology that enables the floss to expand between teeth. This innovation ensures the removal of up to 40% more plaque than standard flosses, offering a deeper, more thorough clean.

Conclusion

Flossing is an integral part of oral hygiene, but not all flosses offer the same benefits. At SuperMouth, we’ve reimagined flossing with your health and well-being in mind. By choosing our flosses, you’re not just cleaning between your teeth; you’re choosing a path of safer, more effective oral care.
